title: tok: a textual concrete syntax of BPMN and DMN for humans and AI agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: tok is a plain-text notation for Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0.2 process models and Decision Model and Notation (DMN) 1.5 decisions. One engine checks a tok document against both standards, compiles the document to XML with an automatic diagram, and serves language-model applications through the Model Context Protocol. The paper classifies the notation as an alternative concrete syntax of the BPMN and DMN metamodels and reports one study. A tok model takes 2.2 times fewer tokens than the smallest BPMN XML of 893 files exported by 37 tools and 7.7 times fewer than the files as exported. The checker signals 98.2% of 1,411 injected faults, against 85.8% for the XML Schema with bpmnlint. Four language models new to tok write valid tok from a one-page reference for 85.7 to 100% of 87 process descriptions from two datasets and valid BPMN XML for every description, and the strongest model writes tok with 25% and 19% fewer tok

translated_title: tok：面向人类和AI智能体的BPMN与DMN文本具体语法
translated_abstract: tok是一种用于业务流程模型与表示法（BPMN）2.0.2流程模型和决策模型与表示法（DMN）1.5决策的纯文本表示法。一个引擎可以依据这两项标准对tok文档进行检查，将文档编译为带有自动生成图表的XML，并通过模型上下文协议为语言模型应用提供服务。该论文将这种表示法归类为BPMN和DMN元模型的另一种具体语法，并报告了一项研究。tok模型所消耗的令牌数量比37种工具导出的893个文件中最小的BPMN XML少2.2倍，比文件按原样导出时少7.7倍。该检查器能够识别1,411个注入故障中的98.2%，而带有bpmnlint的XML Schema只能识别85.8%。四个此前未接触过tok的语言模型仅凭一页参考文档，就能为来自两个数据集的87个流程描述中的85.7%至100%编写出有效的tok，并为每个描述编写出有效的BPMN XML，其中最强的模型编写的tok比标准XML少25%和19%的tok
tldr: 本文提出了tok这一BPMN和DMN的纯文本表示法，其令牌效率比XML高数倍、故障检测率更高，且语言模型能轻松学习并生成有效的tok模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces tok, a plain-text notation for BPMN and DMN that is several times more token-efficient than XML, achieves higher fault detection rates, and can be readily learned and generated by language models.
